response.sql: WITH per_status AS (SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event GROUP BY e.status) SELECT status, member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS proportion FROM per_status

assumptions.assumption: Events with a NULL status are kept as their own group, since the request says to group by event status and does not say to exclude them.

The denominator is the sum of the per-status distinct-member counts, as the request specifies. A member who attended events of several statuses is counted once in each, so the denominator can exceed the number of distinct attending members.
